what_happened: Verified task 417's cited miss (dispatch_seq 5, Phase 4) against its archived plan: Phase 4 was that plan's own final (4th of 4) and only Verification Tier: full phase. The Batch Gate Deferral directive genuinely applied to the phase that missed it -- this is a siting/recency defect, not a final-phase-scoping defect. Confirming this up front rules out the HARD CONSTRAINTS' alternate branch (widen scoping) without needing to explore it further.

Option (2) (restate the directive inside '## Phase Mission') is structurally unavailable for the common, non-hard-mode implement dispatch: orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh only emits '## Phase Mission' when $phase_number is set, which is exclusively an H1 hard-mode per-phase-dispatch construct. An ordinary implement dispatch (the shape of the cited 417 miss) processes all plan phases in one dispatch via general-implementation-agent.md's own internal Stage 4D-iii loop, with no per-phase dispatch-file section to restate into. Option (2) as literally described in the task's SCOPE section would need a different point-of-use site (agent-file prose, already present in Stage 4C) rather than a dispatch-file section, which also makes it awkward to pin with the test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh position fixture the VERIFY section asks for.

Option (3) (batch-aware aggregator) faces a concrete false-positive risk: specs/.orchestration/.orchestrator-multi-state-<session_id>.json files are never cleaned up after a batch invocation finishes (no rm call found in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh/orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh/skill-orchestrate.sh). 8 stale files from past sessions (spanning Nov 6-8) are present in this repository right now. A naive 'does any multi-state file exist with task_numbers>1' detector would misfire against a legitimate standalone run. A correct implementation needs the invoking dispatch to pass its own session_id through to verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh (new plumbing) so detection scopes to THIS session's file, plus a liveness signal, not mere file presence -- confirming the task description's own 'largest change' and fail-open warnings.

validate-artifact.sh in plan mode caught six real authoring defects in the first draft of the plan before it was committed: a wrapped Files-to-modify continuation line beginning with a backtick (which would have silently dropped a path at harvest), three Tier Justification lines under-naming the suite set suite_selection_select actually returns, one justification claiming a suite for paths the selector maps to __FULL_SWEEP__, and two deployed-tree .claude/** paths named directly in a phase's file list. All six were fixed and the plan now validates with zero warnings.

Every file/line citation carried in the task description had drifted by the plan phase: the composer's section echo call sites moved by roughly 50-80 lines each, and general-implementation-agent.md's cited lines 469-470 and 1023 are now ~510-521 and ~1078. The described premise itself was still live in every case (the directive is still emitted after ## Plan and after ## Phase Mission; the anti-pattern text is unchanged in substance), so no re-scoping was needed, but every number in the plan was re-derived rather than copied.

Phase 1 verification suite run (run-all.sh --only ...) showed test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh FAILING pre-existingly: its sandbox REQUIRED_LIB_SCRIPTS list omits lib/project-number-inuse.sh, which state-write.sh depends on, causing 'No such file or directory' inside the sandbox. This suite does not exercise orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's batch_gate_deferral_flag path at all and is unrelated to the Phase 1 hoist edit. test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh itself PASSED. Not fixed here (out of this plan's scope); recorded for visibility.
